prompt:
Create exactly ONE finished, flat, opaque landscape 16:9 Korean community-workshop poster for social media. Use case: ads-marketing. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

The attached image is a newly made supporting layout/type planning diagram only. Take its reading relationships, continuous mature body lettering and relative type roles as guidance; its gray rectangles and simple figures are placeholders. Replace them with rich REAL EDITORIAL PHOTOGRAPHY of recognizable repair actions, real colors and materials. Do not print diagram labels, reproduce neutral gray clipart, or claim exact font-file fidelity. Positions may adapt to the actual photographs while retaining the offset sentence entry, lower-left title, central paragraph and connected event/application routes.

Visual idea: edited photographic montage changes our distance from damage to shared repair. Straight and precise diagonal crop edges interlock, with no paper scraps or boxes. Upper-left close crop: a brown wooden chair's loose mortise/rail-to-leg joint, its open gap visible while enough seat/leg/rail remains to identify a chair. Upper-middle different-scale macro crop: ragged torn edge and fibers of a blue-gray denim work-shirt sleeve. Large right photograph: two different neighbors' hands at one coherent chair joint—one person's hand firmly stabilizes the leg/rail and the other holds a screwdriver with its metal tip physically seated in the visible screw head. Clearly distinct hands, wrists and contact ownership; plausible tool, joint and chair structure. Allow this photograph's left edge to retreat obliquely alongside the central paragraph: first line needs less width, later lines more. Lower-left broader crop of the SAME denim sleeve, moving from tear to reuse with an orange fabric patch and careful stitches; its broad quiet navy textile area opens the title in two lines. Lower-right close crop: two neighbors holding that sleeve together, one supporting the cloth and the other pushing a threaded sewing needle through the torn edge beside the orange patch; visible needle-to-fabric contact. No decorative tool scatter, no faces needed, no empty room. Damage crops and action crops correspond through material, torn edge/joint and directional contact, rather than unrelated stock-photo tiles.

Whole design is image-led photographic crop editing, not a passive information template. Navy and blue-gray denim, warm brown wood, natural skin warmth and a small orange patch create the palette. The central reading surface is cool pale blue-gray with very low detail, visually continuous with the montage's open incision rather than a bordered panel. Photos are crisp and tactile; wood grain, fabric fibers and skin light only on materials. No generic film grain, tape texture, fake paper distress or global noise. Exact straight/diagonal boundaries, consistent natural light, sharp functional contacts. Print text remains on the flat poster plane, never perspectively painted on objects.

Type and reading route: upper-left English comparison phrase in clear semibold sans serif, visually about two-thirds of the light large meaning sentence in the upper-right. That meaning sentence wraps after its comma into two light-weight lines above the working hands, with generous readable counters. Central paragraph is a substantial continuous three-line left-aligned block, dark ink on the pale cool opening; use Korean regular sans-serif anatomy similar to the attached guide's Apple SD Gothic Neo Regular: normal-width square Hangul syllables, open counters, stable joins, even strokes and real word spaces, no stretched glyphs. At a 720px-wide social display aim for roughly 18px body lettering, with comfortable leading; allocate the paragraph area BEFORE cropping images. Wrap after the word 옷을 on line one and after 도구를 on line two. Do not shrink the explanation into a corner. Paragraph's final line leads down along the SAME optical starting axis to the semibold workshop name, then the date in medium weight, then time, venue and participation fee with calm compact line spacing. The lower-left title sits in two medium-weight lines on the broad denim area, breaks after 쓰는, in warm off-white; it identifies the event without overpowering the full explanation. Lower-right application deadline, object invitation and URL form one comfortably readable action group next to the shared needle/cloth contact; allow sufficient low-detail contrast area and edge breathing room. Dates, colons, the long en dash in the time range, middle dot in the fee, Latin slash and URL are clean and readable. Preserve meaning-bearing word spaces; no arbitrary extra letter spacing. All body/event/application lettering is refined print typography, not distressed.

Print ONLY these twelve entries, each exactly ONCE, preserving all Korean/Latin letters, numbers, meaningful word spaces and punctuation. Soft wrapping at word boundaries is allowed. This is the complete printed copy:
고쳐 쓰는 토요일
REPAIR / TOGETHER
버리는 대신, 함께 고칩니다.

repair.example/join

No added slogans, numbers, labels, tiny fake print, logo, watermark or QR. Exclude a solid/near-solid/split-field background dominated by a big gothic heading/date/information template with subordinate little pictures; font substitution or room dressing does not solve that exclusion. The large content-grounded montage's varying distances, crop boundaries and actual repair contacts must organize the copy and whole poster. One single poster, no mockup, frame, contact sheet or multi-poster comparison. Opaque full canvas.
